parsed.name: 超高频量子分析仪（UHFQA）
parsed.description: 这是一台用于量子实验的物理仪器，面向量子比特读出与控制场景。它提供量子分析通道、任意波形发生、序列器程序加载、波形存储器访问、积分权重配置，以及与 PQSC 配合的 QCCS 同步设置。
parsed.description_en: This is a physical instrument for quantum experiments, used for qubit readout and control workflows. It provides quantum analyzer channels, arbitrary waveform generation, sequencer program loading, waveform memory access, integration weight configuration, and QCCS synchronization settings for operation with a PQSC.
